_about: What an agent might say on a call. The person running Spike S1 reads these aloud; Whisper's transcript is compared with the text here. Taglish spelling varies between people, so scores use both word and character error rates.
en: Thank you for calling, how may I help you today?
May I have your account number, please?
I understand your concern, let me check that for you.
Please hold for a moment while I look into your account.
Your refund will be processed within three to five business days.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused you.
For security purposes, can you confirm your full name and birthday?
tl: Magandang araw po, ano po ang maitutulong ko sa inyo?
Pwede ko po bang malaman ang account number ninyo?
Naiintindihan ko po ang inyong problema, susuriin ko po muna.
Maghintay lang po kayo sandali habang tinitingnan ko ang account ninyo.
Maibabalik po ang bayad ninyo sa loob ng tatlo hanggang limang araw.
May iba pa po ba akong maitutulong sa inyo?
Humihingi po kami ng paumanhin sa abalang naidulot nito.
Para po sa seguridad, pakikumpirma po ang buo ninyong pangalan at petsa ng kapanganakan.
taglish: Hello po, thank you for calling, ano po ang maitutulong ko sa inyo today?
Pwede ko po bang makuha yung account number ninyo?
Okay po sir, i-check ko lang po muna yung account niyo.
Please hold lang po saglit habang chine-check ko yung billing ninyo.
Yung refund po ninyo ay ma-process within three to five working days.
Is there anything else po na pwede kong i-assist sa inyo?
Sorry po sa abala, we will fix this po as soon as possible.
For verification po, pakisabi lang po yung full name at birthday ninyo.
